description: Institution directory for SGT George Ramos manuscript submission campaign. One record per institution. Status values: planned | submitted | under_review | accepted | declined | archived

fields.name: text — official institution name
fields.type: keyword — university | foundation | archive | gov_agency | think_tank | veterans_org
fields.focus_area: keyword array — military | chicano_studies | humanities | public_policy | immigration | veterans
fields.record_type_interest: text — what they hold relevant to this project
fields.stress_test_claim: text — the specific claim directed at their holdings
fields.footprint_log_entry: keyword — ID in electronic footprint log

institutions.name: USC Libraries Special Collections — Chicano Studies Research Center
